research_item_name: Policy, macro conditions and cost of ownership
source_title: Interpretation of the 2026 Automobile Trade-in Subsidy Implementation Rules
Announcement on Continuing and Optimizing the NEV Purchase Tax Reduction Policy
evidence_excerpt: The 2026 scrappage subsidy is 12% of the new NEV selling price, capped at CNY 20,000; eligible replacement of an old vehicle with a new NEV receives 8%, capped at CNY 15,000.
For eligible internal-combustion passenger vehicles of 2.0 litres or below, the 2026 scrappage subsidy is 10%, capped at CNY 15,000, and the replacement subsidy is 6%, capped at CNY 13,000.
NEV passenger-vehicle purchase tax changes from exemption in 2024-2025, capped at CNY 30,000 per vehicle, to a 50% reduction in 2026-2027, capped at CNY 15,000 per vehicle.
scope_and_caliber: National policy rules for eligible passenger-vehicle purchases in mainland China. These are policy parameters, not measured sales effects.
metric_value_and_unit: NEV purchase tax: 50% reduction in 2026-2027, maximum CNY 15,000
comparison_period: 2024-2025 NEV purchase-tax exemption versus 2026-2027 50% tax reduction; 2026 subsidy rules only.
contribution_or_rank_change: [uncertain] No source in this batch quantifies sales contribution by policy, region, powertrain or price band.
segment_definition: Owners of eligible old passenger vehicles who buy catalogue-qualified NEVs or eligible 2.0-litre-and-below internal-combustion passenger vehicles.
structure_change: The policy design continues to support vehicle renewal while the NEV tax incentive becomes less generous than in 2024-2025.
representative_models: [uncertain] Model-level eligibility and transaction data were not collected in this research item.
lifecycle_event: From 2026-01-01, vehicles must meet the applicable catalogue and technical requirements to receive the tax reduction and trade-in subsidy.
overall_judgement: 2026 policy provides a nationwide replacement-demand floor, but it is a targeted renewal mechanism rather than evidence of broad-based demand expansion. The lower NEV purchase-tax benefit changes the incentive mix and must be evaluated together with transaction price and local implementation data.
observed_fact: The government rules define different subsidy rates for NEV and eligible internal-combustion purchases, while the tax rule reduces the maximum NEV tax benefit from CNY 30,000 to CNY 15,000.
causal_mechanism: A qualifying old-car owner can receive a larger direct subsidy when replacing with an NEV than with an eligible internal-combustion vehicle. This improves the economics of renewal purchases, but the net demand effect cannot be inferred without applications, approval speed, transaction prices and local funding data.
confidence_level: Medium for policy mechanics; low for measured demand impact.
alternative_explanations: Product launches, financing, fuel prices, local subsidy execution, dealer discounts and consumer income expectations may dominate demand outcomes in individual regions or price bands.
competitive_set: Catalogue-qualified NEVs versus eligible 2.0-litre-and-below internal-combustion passenger vehicles in the renewal market.
competitive_advantage_or_barrier: NEV renewal purchases have a higher national subsidy ceiling, but catalogue qualification and local application execution remain entry conditions.
configuration_threshold: Catalogue qualification and the applicable NEV technical requirements are mandatory for the policy benefit; configuration preference is outside this evidence set.
pricing_and_profit_signal: The sources provide statutory benefit ceilings, not dealer transaction prices, discount cost sharing or vehicle profitability.
target_user_segment: Existing passenger-car owners with eligible old vehicles and a feasible replacement budget.
purchase_motivation_and_pain_points: A direct purchase incentive can reduce replacement cost; the actual motivation mix remains [uncertain] without consumer or application records.
purchase_barrier: Eligibility cut-off dates, required documentation, local processing and the remaining purchase price can restrict conversion.
channel_signal: Subsidy application and approval records, regional application ageing and dealer conversion by programme should be monitored before attributing sales to policy.
opportunity_or_risk_grade: B: policy-supported renewal opportunity, pending measured conversion evidence.
recommended_action: Target eligible renewal cohorts and communicate verified benefit eligibility, while keeping the 2026 tax-rule change explicit in price and financing scenarios.
regional_capacity_or_channel_action: Allocate local marketing and dealer resources only after confirming provincial programme rules, funding rhythm and application service levels.
decision_condition_and_trigger: Upgrade to an A-grade opportunity only if internal data shows incremental conversion and contribution after controlling for price, launch timing and regional funding availability.
next_verification: Collect regional application counts, approval time, subsidy exhaustion status, transaction price bands, old-car age and powertrain of replacement purchases.
data_quality_status: Passed for policy facts; incomplete for policy-effect measurement.
data_gap_or_conflict: No internal application data, regional execution data, price-band conversion data or causal counterfactual was included in this batch.
claim_boundary: This item confirms rules and incentive direction. It does not prove that policy caused a specific sales change or that one powertrain will outperform in every region.
